_provenance: The Masters panel (docs/14 Step 9, webXBRL's Company / Director / Auditor masters). sections: the statements whose facts the panel edits, found by ELR title (the same title in both taxonomies; never an ELR code) — the non-dimensional items as a card, the single-typed-axis tables as grids. vocabularies: free-text elements whose values MCA expects from a fixed list (doc 13 §13.1: a free-text designation fails the MCA tool), each with the taxonomy enumeration type that holds the list; the panel offers it as a dropdown and still accepts other text, because the schema does not restrict the element. formats: format checks the taxonomy type does not carry (the ICAI membership number is 6 digits). panNames: the pre-scrutiny pair 'the auditor's name must match the PAN' (doc 13 §11.5): which name the PAN belongs to for each category, and the PAN holder type (4th character) that category has. The builder checks every reference against the taxonomy. Chosen by the product owner 2026-11-14.
